details:
People don’t buy the best option, they buy the easiest one. Convenience will always win their wallet.

Right now there are many online marketplaces to buy Unity assets for VRChat avatar and asset creators.

These include Gumroad, Jinxxy, direct purchases from creators, and various evil piracy-oriented options.

I don't mean to be rude, but I think your marketplace comes off harsh to the heart of VRChat. 

VRChat is a paradise for creators, offering unlimited possibilities for custom worlds and experiences. Additionally, you can look stylish while using your expensive setup to enjoy this free second-life experience. 

What I'm proposing is an open marketplace for Unity assets catered for VRChat, uploaded by creators. The marketplace will be organized, searchable, quick, and easy to use, all for the low price of those purple V-Bucks. Add 10–30% off the top of the sale and a verified creator badge, and everyone will use this convenient option over those shady asset stores that prioritize the marketplace's profit over user experience. You can have both; this is VRChat. 

Features that would go hard:

	After a purchase, you own the asset and can verify it with anyone working on your avatar. 

	Purchased assets are added to a downloads manager in VRCC (Creator Companion), keeping things organized. 

	Different kinds of purchases—self-use, public use. 

	Let users view assets before buying; let's say it's a clothing asset. Let them load a blank base with the clothing to check it out before buying. 

	You have age verification and sell 18+ assets on the marketplace to verified users; this will push people to get VRC+ and so on. 

	Sell bases, clothing, items, shaders, everything. 

	Consider implementing a 'for-you' page that suggests clothing based on users' purchases; for example, if a user buys a base, the page would display clothing options suitable for that avatar.
title: Marketplace++
